column1: # piece: Beethoven, Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93, I. Allegro vivace e con brio, bars 1-110
# edition: Breitkopf & Haertel, Beethovens Werke Serie 1 No. 8 (IMSLP #61814), pdf <work>/dl/scores/b8.pdf
# page 9: bars 102-112 in system 1 (102, 103 = 1st ending, 104 = 2nd ending, 105-112); system 2 is bars 113ff (not transcribed)
# time signature 3/4 throughout; beat unit = quarter note (3 beats per bar)
# bar numbering: counted from the movement start; the 1st ending (repeat back to bar 1) is bar 103, the 2nd ending bar 104, so the development begins 105

# staves: Flauti, Oboi, Clarinetti in B, Fagotti, Corni in F, Trombe in F (two players per staff), Timpani in F.C., Violino I, II, Viola, Violoncello, Basso (cello and bass on separate staves throughout)
# shared staves: a player was taken to rest where a whole-bar rest is printed under/over the other voice; one notehead with stems up and down = both play (no a2 text in this edition)
# a dynamic printed once on a shared staff is given to each player who plays
# notes end = end of the last note before a rest of a whole bar or longer
# not transcribed as rows (no level change): tempo words ritard. (bars 43, 51, 53, 62) / a tempo (44, 52, 54), staccato dots, written-out tremolo slashes (vl2 52-62, vl2/vla 63-66 etc.)
# doubts: pp at 55:1 and 59:1 read as timp's (sits between timp and vl1); cl2 at 84:3; both bassoons in bar 91; hn2 at 62:1 (single notehead, given to both)
